name: Teens Helping Seniors
what_you_do: Teens earn school community service credit. They serve seniors in Woodland.
deadline_text: No dates on the Teen Programs page.
how_to_apply: Register online through the Woodland Community Services registration portal (linked from the Teen Programs page) or call (530) 661-2000. Email: WoodlandCSD@cityofwoodland.gov.
notes: The page gives no hours, dates or fees. Call Community Services to ask how it works and when to start.
